answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose to leverage the task of summarization as a testbed for evaluating long-context models and RAG systems.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries of insights relevant to a query, in bullet-point format with citations.

answer_2.quote: Our second contribution develops SummHay's evaluation protocol, centering on evaluating system outputs on their Coverage of reference insights, and the quality of their Citation.

answer_3.quote: We then experiment with LLM-based evaluation, finding that although the level of correlation is slightly lower (0.71), evaluation cost is reduced by a factor of almost 50.

answer_4.quote: To establish the reproducibility of the evaluation protocol, two authors of the paper and two professional annotators independently annotated a common subset of 35 summaries...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to determine coverage of reference insights and citation quality.
